messages:
deploy-bot: rollout complete: v2.18.3 -> canary-usw2. starting post-deploy smoke suite (kvprobe, synths, healthchecks). dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/rollouts/3259990000 :rocket:
sam: early flag: kvprobe for prefix 'prefill-search' shows a sudden miss-rate jump and p95 latency spike around 3259990020. small sample but correlated with synth 504s. :grimacing:
hana: snippet from probe:
```
[3259990018] kvprobe prefix=prefill-search miss_rate=0.04 latency=40ms
[3259990019] kvprobe prefix=prefill-search miss_rate=0.52 latency=720ms trace=tx-pre1
[3259990021] synth /search-autocomplete -> 504 upstream_timeout trace=tx-pre2
```
peter: metrics show one canary host had a warmup delay and a brief kernel fallback burst. canary traffic is 5% overall, /search-autocomplete is ~30% of that.
infra-bot: incident candidate flagged: kv-warmup-prefill (severity: low). recommend limiting canary traffic for affected route while triage runs.
sam: proposal: split routing for /search-autocomplete: stable gets 95%, canary 5% to keep some signal but limit blast radius. command: ```redwoodctl routing set --route /search-autocomplete --versions v2.17.9:95,v2.18.3:5 --reason "postdeploy kvprobe prefill miss spike"```
hana: applying now... :running_woman:
deploy-bot: routing change applied by hana at 3259990031. audit id r-audit-12999.
hana: after split, p95 dropped to ~130ms within ~40s and 504s cleared. looks much better. :thumbsup:
peter: opening ticket RINF-8322 "v2.18.3 prefill-search kv warmup regression" and attaching traces + kvheatmap. assigning to serving-ops + infra.
qa-bot: scheduled 10m recheck of synths and kvprobe. will post summary.
sam: action items: sam monitor 20m, peter collect host warmup logs and kernel diffs, hana update release notes with temporary split and ticket link. escalate to full rollback if recurrence affects >2 prefixes or persists >15m.
infra-bot: 10m check: metrics stable so far. leaving thread open for follow-up notes. :white_check_mark:
